criteria.criterion: crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md no longer tells the producer to run the full `cargo test --locked` or to report it. It says to run targeted tests (`cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`) while working and that Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate.
criteria.evidence: Read the diff. The old bullet is gone, along with 'not-run is not acceptable'. The new bullet says: 'run targeted tests (`cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`) ... Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full test suite on the candidate after you, so you need not run the full suite'. Prompt budget tests are part of the recorded passing `cargo test --locked` run (993 tests).

criteria.criterion: In crates/athena-core/src/run.rs the producer loop no longer sends a report back for lacking a real full `cargo test --locked` result. The `ran_full_tests` and `tests_missing` gating and the sent-back test text are removed. The send-back for unmet acceptance criteria is kept.
criteria.evidence: Read the diff. FULL_TEST_COMMAND, ran_full_tests, enforce_tests, tests_missing and the 'Sent back' test paragraph are removed. The loop breaks when `unmet.is_empty()`. The unmet-criteria send-back and PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS remain. A grep for FULL_TEST_COMMAND or ran_full_tests finds them only in docs/decisions.md.

criteria.criterion: The checks Athena runs on the candidate (fmt, clippy, full test) and their effect on the final verdict are unchanged. A failing check still fails the candidate. The producer-report-gaps note to the verifier no longer tells it to run the full suite, and the verifier prompt still says to cite recorded results.
criteria.evidence: The diff does not touch checks.rs or the verdict code. In the gaps note, the instruction to run `{FULL_TEST_COMMAND}` became 'judge them yourself from the recorded check results and run only a check whose record is missing or failed', and a lifecycle test now asserts this. crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md is untouched and still has the 'Cite them' instruction. a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier_and_every_criterion_is_judged and try_again_on_a_job_rejected_by_a_check_carries_the_failed_checks_output pass.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle`. The tests show that a producer report with no full-suite check, or with `not-run`, goes to the verifier without a send-back. A report with unmet criteria is still sent back once. A candidate whose recorded test check fails is still rejected.
criteria.evidence: 61 passed, 0 failed. a_report_without_a_full_test_result_goes_to_the_verifier_without_a_send_back covers four reports: not-run, fail, none and targeted. Each gives 1 producer call, reaches the verifier and has no 'sent back' line. a_criterion_unmet_before_verification_goes_back_to_the_producer_not_the_verifier passes, so unmet criteria are still sent back once. a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier_and_every_criterion_is_judged passes, so a failing check is still rejected. With the old gate, the new test's 1-producer assertion would have seen 2 calls and failed.

summary: The code and prompt change does what was asked. The producer prompt now asks for targeted tests. run.rs no longer gates on a full `cargo test --locked` result, and the unmet-criteria send-back stays. The gaps note now points the verifier to the recorded check results. The candidate checks and their verdict effect are untouched. I ran the lifecycle tests (61 passed, including a new test of four report variants with no send-back), clippy with -D warnings, and fmt --check, and all were clean. The candidate still fails on criterion 6. CHANGELOG.md has only one release heading ([0.1.0] at line 1225), so the D95 entry at line 624 is still in [Unreleased] and still says 'The producer must run the full `cargo test --locked` before it finishes'. The plan treated it as an old released entry, but it is not. Amending that entry would let this pass. Smaller points: D103's text still says to run the tests, with no pointer to D113, and D113 repeats one sentence.
